1. The HTTP method should be URL-encoded

`HTTP_METHOD&BASE_STRING_URI&NORMALIZED_PARAMETERS`

    from oauthlib.common import urlencode
    return "{}&{}&{}".format(
        urlencode(http_method.upper()),
